name: Counterexample: the woe.* holder-behavior instruments fail a live window whose measures were missed (goal 60d3a8, W1)
commandNote: Same live grading instrument as goal-holder-woe-live-windows-2026-10-03.json (collectGoalHolderBehaviorMetrics + rateGoalHolderBehavior over the live Postgres ledger). This record exists to show the instrument is falsifiable on live data: on a window where measures were genuinely missed, it rates them fail.
summary: W1 (07:49:40Z-09:49:40Z, holder su-a70547cc, card EI-24951369356377001) is a live counterexample: two of the five holder-behavior measures were genuinely missed in the ledger, and the instruments rated both fail. nudge-efficacy failed on 22 obligation-reminder watches cancelled with NULL cancel_reason (root cause filed as WI-10005938). holder-plan-authorship failed on one overdue unplanned cluster (anchor EI-23772322660353682, 4 items) that was neither planned nor dismissed in the window (root cause filed as WI-10005942: the signal-5 detector was absent from the holder's serving build until 09:20:41Z). The instrument therefore distinguishes a missed window from a passing one (W2, card EI-24961458823340256, 5 of 5 pass).
scope: Live ledger read for one 2h window. Falsifiability evidence for the R-7 live-window clauses; it does not grade the holder's behavior on its own.
